rule.plain_words: A page is worth a CTR review if it's visible, ranks in the top 20, and its CTR is below the median CTR of other visible pages at the same position tier.

weak_picks_found: 6 of top 10 rows belong to a single client -- global absolute-score ranking structurally favors high-traffic clients
2 of top 10 rows have <=1 click on 58k-84k impressions -- likely a tracking/indexing artifact, not a content problem
